message: The caller said a customer profile check required my internet banking password.
A sender claimed a delivery had been held and instructed me to pay through an unverified page at https://parcel.invalid.
An unknown person requests a debit authorization and claims it is only a balance check.
The caller insisted that I stay on camera and threatened my family if I contacted anyone about the payment.
Someone claimed I was under virtual custody and said I could only disconnect after paying him.
The caller said the alleged case would disappear if I paid his intermediary.
A stranger sent an alleged court notice and requested payment to cancel the proceedings.
A message claimed a warrant had been issued and demanded a settlement through a personal payment address.
A person claimed my parcel had been intercepted at the border and demanded payment outside the official carrier system.
Someone claiming to be from bank support wanted the secret number on the back of my card.
An alleged bank agent said I needed to install a remote access app so he could update my customer profile.
A supposed logistics worker demanded an unofficial fine before releasing my order.
